name: LightCarbon Speed7 105 mechanical complete bike
why_interesting: The official Chinese catalog resolves Speed7/速7 as LCR017-D and supplies exact platform specifications, while the retained mechanical-105 package weight remains unproven.
missing: Exact retained mechanical-105 bill of materials and complete-bike weight basis
Current checkout and domestic warranty/after-sales entity
price_status: dated screenshot observation; live checkout unverified

facts.wheels: Carbon wheelset listing claim; exact wheel model and package mapping remain unverified
facts.frame: Speed7/速7 is the official Chinese-market alias for the LCR017-D Toray T700+T800+T1000 platform
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Official Chinese catalog alias bridge to the exact LCR017-D manufacturer maximum
facts.factory_weight_context: Manufacturer social post claims 7.8 kg for 7120, 7.5 kg for 7170 and 7.2 kg for 8170; none is mapped to the retained mechanical-105 package
facts.frame_stiffness_status: Qualitative ride evidence is available; no numeric frame-only measurement is recorded.
facts.stiffness_evidence: A review of the exact LCR017D platform reports solid behavior under load for a custom review build. In a later public comment, the author attributes higher stiffness to the box-shaped downtube. Qualitative review and community-report evidence; no numeric baseline or controlled frame-only test, and the selected factory quality/build is not mapped to the retained mechanical-105 package.
facts.separate owner custom-build reference: A post published2025-11-09 describes a Speed7/017 custom bike with a GRX/UltegraDi2 mix, R7000 chain/cassette, XXE/Xcadey, Goldix180SL custom wheels and MVMT cockpit, and claims6.98kg including clipless pedals. Size and scales/method are unstated. This is separate owner-build context; retained mechanical105 complete weight/BOM and SPEEDZ identity remain unresolved. Hypothetical6.8kg and title10k are not observed weight/exact price.

source_note: The official Chinese catalog maps 速7 to LCR017-D. Its 32C maximum therefore applies to the retained platform, but factory 7.8/7.5/7.2 kg social claims are not assigned to the retained mechanical-105 build. September22 follow-up adds attributed qualitative ride evidence with its build and source caveats; it does not supply an exact complete weight or maximum clearance.

enrichment_reviews.scope: LightCarbon Speed7/LCR017-D bare-frame reference; retained mechanical-105 complete build and its package are not shown. Source reuse only; no new search or complete-build claim.
Dated public reference only. Exact selected-build quantitative gaps and existing evidence/dates remain intact.
